about: Discrepancies found by these tests and reported for a fix. Each is still tested on every run and published as failing; it does not fail CI. Remove an entry when the fix ships; the run then fails if the problem comes back.

issues.summary: The market transparency index shown in the browser (transparency-index/ti-core.js) and the open Python rule (open/scoring.py transparency_index) can differ by 0.1 point: both round a floating-point sum, JavaScript half up with Math.round and Python half to even with round(), and they add the terms in a different order.
issues.fix: Compute the index from integers in both languages: x = 100*sum(score) + 50*sum(vscore) + 100*projects_without_flags (for six-check projects); index = floor((2*x + n) / (2*n)) / 10, i.e. round half up of x/n tenths.
